summary: SP-021 accessibility & localization COMPLETED. Added stable non-localized onboarding/header accessibility identifiers (onboardingPrimary/Skip/Close, languageSwitch, settingsButton, onboardingButton). Fixed live Turkish localization defects: status pill (AuraAppStatus.title(for:) + AuraAppModel.displayStatusDetail), capability ready/no-evidence detail (capabilities.noEvidence), and disabled/degraded capability reason prose (AuraAppModel.localizedReason(_:)). Fixed the AuraAgentTests exit-142 flake: the buffered ProcessRunner now always sets a closed stdin pipe, so claude --help no longer blocks on inherited stdin EOF. Fixed Dynamic Type scaling: AuraDesign.Typography now uses relative text styles. Live accessibility verification with the user present: AX reading order logical and complete (header -> status -> language -> actions -> tabs -> content -> composer); keyboard-only focus reaches every primary control; TR/EN copy renders correctly; non-color status, keyboard shortcuts, confirmation expiry/focus containment, reduced motion (no animations) verified. AURAIntegrationTests 88/88, AuraAgentTests 237/237, full suite 21/21 bundles 0 failed, validator PASSED. SP-021 completed; SP-022 is next eligible and pending.
